children.name: XcpConfig
children.description: This container contains the configuration parameters and sub containers of the AUTOSAR Xcp module.

children.name: XcpDaqList
children.description: This container contains the configuration of the DAQs.

children.name: XcpDaqListNumber
children.description: Index number of the DAQ list

children.name: XcpDaqListType
children.description: This indicates whether this DAQ list represents a DAQ or a STIM.

metadata.LITERALS: DAQ AUTOSAR_ECUC DAQ_STIM AUTOSAR_ECUC STIM AUTOSAR_ECUC

children.name: XcpMaxOdt
children.description: MAX_ODT indicates the maximum amount of ODTs in this DAQ list

children.name: XcpMaxOdtEntries
children.description: This parameter indicates the maximum amount of entries in an ODT of this DAQ list (STATIC configuration).

children.name: XcpDto
children.description: This container collects data transfer object specific parameters for the DAQ list.

children.name: XcpDtoPid
children.description: Packet identifier (PID) of the DTO that identifies the ODT the content of the DTO.

children.name: XcpDto2PduMapping
children.description: This reference specifies the mapping of the DTO to the PDUs from the lower-layer interfaces (CanIf, FrIf, SoAd and Cdd).

metadata.INTRODUCTION: A reference to a XcpRxPdu is only feasible if the the DaqListType is DAQ_STIM. A reference to a XcpTxPdu is only feasible if the DaqListType is DAQ.

children.name: XcpOdt
children.description: This container contains ODT-specific parameter for the DAQ list.

children.name: XcpOdtEntryMaxSize
children.description: This parameter indicates the upper limit for the size of the element described by an ODT entry. Depending on the DaqListType this ODT belongs to it describes the limit for a DAQ (MAX_ODT_ENTRY_SIZE_DAQ) or a STIM (MAX_ODT_ENTRY_SIZE_STIM).

children.name: XcpOdtNumber
children.description: Index number of this ODT within the DAQ list.

children.name: XcpOdt2DtoMapping
children.description: This reference maps the ODT to the according DTO in which it will be transmitted.

children.name: XcpOdtEntry
children.description: This container collects all configuration parameters that comprise an ODT entry.

children.name: XcpOdtEntryAddress
children.description: Memory address that the ODT entry is referencing to.

children.name: XcpOdtEntryBitOffset
children.description: Represent the bit offset in case of the element represents status bit.

children.name: XcpOdtEntryLength
children.description: Length of the referenced memory area that is referenced by the ODT entry.

children.name: XcpOdtEntryNumber
children.description: Index number of the ODT entry

children.name: XcpEventChannel
children.description: This container contains the configuration of event channels on the XCP slave.

children.name: XcpEventChannelConsistency
children.description: Type of consistency used by event channel

metadata.LITERALS: DAQ AUTOSAR_ECUC EVENT AUTOSAR_ECUC ODT AUTOSAR_ECUC

children.name: XcpEventChannelMaxDaqList
children.description: Maximum amount of DAQ lists that are handled by this event channel.

children.name: XcpEventChannelNumber
children.description: Index number of the event channel.

children.name: XcpEventChannelPriority
children.description: Priority of the event channel

children.name: XcpEventChannelTimeCycle
children.description: The event channel time cycle indicates which sampling period is used to process this event channel. A value of 0 means 'Not cyclic'.

children.name: XcpEventChannelTimeUnit
children.description: This configuration parameter indicates the unit of the event channel time cycle.

metadata.LITERALS: TIMESTAMP_UNIT_100MS AUTOSAR_ECUC TIMESTAMP_UNIT_100NS AUTOSAR_ECUC TIMESTAMP_UNIT_100PS AUTOSAR_ECUC TIMESTAMP_UNIT_100US AUTOSAR_ECUC TIMESTAMP_UNIT_10MS AUTOSAR_ECUC TIMESTAMP_UNIT_10NS AUTOSAR_ECUC TIMESTAMP_UNIT_10PS AUTOSAR_ECUC TIMESTAMP_UNIT_10US AUTOSAR_ECUC TIMESTAMP_UNIT_1MS AUTOSAR_ECUC TIMESTAMP_UNIT_1NS AUTOSAR_ECUC TIMESTAMP_UNIT_1PS AUTOSAR_ECUC TIMESTAMP_UNIT_1S AUTOSAR_ECUC TIMESTAMP_UNIT_1US AUTOSAR_ECUC

children.name: XcpEventChannelType
children.description: This configuration parameter indicates what kind of DAQ list can be allocated to this event channel.

metadata.LITERALS: DAQ AUTOSAR_ECUC DAQ_STIM AUTOSAR_ECUC STIM AUTOSAR_ECUC

children.name: XcpEventChannelTriggeredDaqListRef
children.description: References all DAQ lists that are trigged by this event channel.

children.name: XcpPdu
children.description: Contains PDU information. A PDU may be either a transmission PDU or a reception PDU.

children.name: XcpRxPdu
children.description: This container specifies received PDUs.

children.name: XcpRxPduId
children.description: ID of the PDU that will be received via a Xcp_<module>RxIndication.

children.name: XcpTxPdu
children.description: This container specifies transmission PDUs.

children.name: XcpTxPduId
children.description: The PDU identifier, which has to be used by the lower layer BSW module for TxConfirmations or TriggerTransmits.

children.name: XcpTxPduRef
children.description: Reference to the external PDU definition.

children.name: XcpGeneral
children.description: This container contains the general configuration parameters of the XCP.

children.name: XcpDaqConfigType
children.description: Sets the DAQ_CONFIG_TYPE bit within the DAQ_PROPERTIES parameter to "static" or to "dynamic". If DAQ_STATIC is selected, the DAQ_CONFIG_TYPE bit is set to "0". If DAQ_DYNAMIC is selected, the DAQ_CONFIG_TYPE bit is set to "1".

children.name: XcpDaqCount
children.description: Indicates the number of DAQ lists for dynamic configuration.

children.name: XcpDevErrorDetect
children.description: Switches the Default Error Tracer (Det) detection and notification ON or OFF.

children.name: XcpFlashProgrammingEnabled
children.description: Enabling of XCP Flash programming functionality

children.name: XcpIdentificationFieldType
children.description: Type of Identification Field the slave will use when transferring DAQ Packets to the master. The master has to use the same Type of Identification Field when transferring STIM Packets to the slave.

metadata.LITERALS: ABSOLUTE AUTOSAR_ECUC RELATIVE_BYTE AUTOSAR_ECUC RELATIVE_WORD AUTOSAR_ECUC RELATIVE_WORD_ALIGNED AUTOSAR_ECUC

children.name: XcpMainFunctionPeriod
children.description: The XCP does not require this information but the BSW scheduler, which invokes the main function, needs it in order to plan its tasks.

children.name: XcpMaxCto
children.description: MAX_CTO shows the maximum length of a CTO packet in bytes.

children.name: XcpMaxDto
children.description: MAX_DTO shows the maximum length of a DTO packet in bytes.

children.name: XcpMinDaq
children.description: Indicates the number of predefined, read only DAQ lists on the XCP slave.

children.name: XcpOdtCount
children.description: This parameter indicates the amount of ODTs of a DAQ list using dynamic DAQ list configuration.

children.name: XcpOdtEntriesCount
children.description: Indicates the amount of entries into an ODT using dynamic DAQ list configuration.

children.name: XcpOdtEntrySizeDaq
children.description: Indicates the size of an element described by an ODT entry to the DaqListType for a DAQ.

children.name: XcpOdtEntrySizeStim
children.description: Indicates the size of an element described by an ODT entry to the DaqListType for a stim.

children.name: XcpOnCanEnabled
children.description: Enabling of XCPonCAN functionality

children.name: XcpOnCddEnabled
children.description: Enabling of XCPonCdd functionality

children.name: XcpOnEthernetEnabled
children.description: Enabling of XCPonEthernet functionality

children.name: XcpOnFlexRayEnabled
children.description: Enabling of XCPonFlexRay functionality

children.name: XcpPrescalerSupported
children.description: This parameter enables and disables the support for Prescaler support. True is Enabled, False is disabled

children.name: XcpSuppressTxSupport
children.description: Switches the support of suppressing transmission of PDUs per communication channel on or off.

metadata.INTRODUCTION: TRUE: Suppressing of TxPDUs supported FALSE: Suppressing of TxPDUs not supported

children.name: XcpTimestampTicks
children.description: This parameter defines the timestamp that will increment based TIMESTAMP_TICKS per unit and wrap around if an overflow occurs.

children.name: XcpTimestampType
children.description: This parameter indicates the number of bytes used for the timestamp field. In case No_TIME_STAMP is selected the timestamp field is not available.

metadata.LITERALS: FOUR_BYTE AUTOSAR_ECUC NO_TIME_STAMP AUTOSAR_ECUC ONE_BYTE AUTOSAR_ECUC TWO_BYTE AUTOSAR_ECUC

children.name: XcpTimestampUnit
children.description: This parameter indicates the resolution of the data acquisition clock of the slave when transferring data to master.

metadata.LITERALS: TIMESTAMP_UNIT_100MS AUTOSAR_ECUC TIMESTAMP_UNIT_100NS AUTOSAR_ECUC TIMESTAMP_UNIT_100PS AUTOSAR_ECUC TIMESTAMP_UNIT_100US AUTOSAR_ECUC TIMESTAMP_UNIT_10MS AUTOSAR_ECUC TIMESTAMP_UNIT_10NS AUTOSAR_ECUC TIMESTAMP_UNIT_10PS AUTOSAR_ECUC TIMESTAMP_UNIT_10US AUTOSAR_ECUC TIMESTAMP_UNIT_1MS AUTOSAR_ECUC TIMESTAMP_UNIT_1NS AUTOSAR_ECUC TIMESTAMP_UNIT_1PS AUTOSAR_ECUC TIMESTAMP_UNIT_1S AUTOSAR_ECUC TIMESTAMP_UNIT_1US AUTOSAR_ECUC

children.name: XcpVersionInfoApi
children.description: Enables/disables the existence of the XCP_GetVersionInfo() API service.

metadata.INTRODUCTION: TRUE: XCP_GetVersionInfo() API service exists FALSE: XCP_GetVersionInfo() API service does not exist

children.name: XcpCounterRef
children.description: This parameter contains a reference to the counter, which is used by XCP.

children.name: XcpNvRamBlockIdRef
children.description: This reference contains the link to a non-volatile memory block to be used in the feature "RESUME MODE" so this information has to be stored non volatile to be available directly after start-up of the ECU.
